newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers, Incyte in licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers, Incyte in licensing pact.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said it has reached a licensing agreement with Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc that will provide Bristol-Myers access to Incyte's LifeSeq DNA sequence and gene expression database.

The multi-year agreement will strengthen Bristol-Myers's drug discovery efforts in broad-based genomics and will complement the company's existing systems that provide new methods for identifying innovative therapies, the company said.
Under the agreement, Bristol-Myers said it will obtain access to Incyte's database of human cDNA and its software to utilize the genomic database.
Incyte would receive specific milestone payments and royalties on sales of any marketed products that result from the licensing agreement. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

Icyte chief executive Roy A. Whitfield commented: "With the addition of Bristol-Myers Squibb, Incyte's penetration of the top 10 pharmaceutical companies worldwide, as ranked by research and development spending, has reached 70 percent.

"This represents a powerful consortium of pharmaceutical companies capable of exploiting the vast resources in Incyte's LifeSeq database over a broad array of potential disease areas." ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
